title: Discovery of High-Performance Ni0.62Fe0.23Ce0.15O Electrocatalyst for Oxygen Evolution Reaction via Active Machine Learning.
summary: RFR and genetic search nominated a mixed-metal oxide subsequently tested for oxygen evolution. Electrochemical validation supports the catalyst result; DFT supplies interpretation.
organization: China University of Mining and Technology - Beijing; Anhui University of Technology; City University of Hong Kong

evidence.tested: RFR and genetic search nominated a mixed-metal oxide subsequently tested for oxygen evolution. Electrochemical validation supports the catalyst result; DFT supplies interpretation.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Random-forest regression with genetic optimization is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
